LanguageData.TM_60mmMortar.description: Soften up enemy targets before a fight even begins with a personal mortar system. The 60mm Mortar can easily be transported by a Super Soldier and quickly deployed to launch 3-rounds of indirect fire.
LanguageData.TM_60mmMortar.label: 60mm Mortar
LanguageData.TM_BreachingCharge.description: Throws a specialized explosive that excels at destroying structures or stopping enemy clusters. Deals 30x damage to structures.
LanguageData.TM_BreachingCharge.label: Breaching charge
LanguageData.TM_Buckshot.description: A shotgun shell that fires multiple pellets. The sheer volume of rounds discharged can be devastating at short range, but disperses rapidly.
LanguageData.TM_Buckshot.label: Buckshot
LanguageData.TM_CQC.description: Close Quarters Combat (CQC) is common training for Soldiers that allows them to smoothly execute a vicious combo attack against an enemy in melee range.
LanguageData.TM_CQC.label: CQC
LanguageData.TM_FirstAid.description: Self Aid is possible for Super Soldiers as a result of the genetic enhancements they acquire from the serum. This ability allows them to consciously focus energy to rapid tend wounds. Self Aid is unable to tend grievous wounds, such as missing body parts.
LanguageData.TM_FirstAid.label: Self Aid
LanguageData.TM_Mk203GL.description: Fires a grenade using the Mk203 under-barrel grenade launcher.
LanguageData.TM_Mk203GL.label: Mk203_GL
LanguageData.TM_PistolSpec.description:
Weapon Specialization: Pistol
This specialization improves all aspects of pistols: accuracy, damage, shot delay, shot count, range, and more. Weapon specializations apply automatically when a Super Soldier equips a weapon in their specialization category. Specialized weapons are denoted by a "++" after the item name.
Super Soldiers with a specialized pistol equipped gain a unique "double tap" talent which will occasionally ignore cooldown and immediately begin another shot burst; this talent consumes stamina when it occurs.
LanguageData.TM_PistolSpec.label: Pistol Specialization
LanguageData.TM_PistolSpec_Base0.description: A pistol in the hands of a specialist.
LanguageData.TM_PistolSpec_Base0.label: pistol spec weapon
LanguageData.TM_PistolSpec_Base0.tools.0.label: pistol whip
LanguageData.TM_PistolWhip.description: A sudden attack using the pistol stock as a blunt weapon; successful attacks will stun a target, leaving them dazed for a short period, and may also disarm them.
LanguageData.TM_PistolWhip.label: Pistol Whip
